title: Personal Training Packages: habitual late-cancellation threshold, window, and surcharge by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, the count of late cancellations that triggers the habitual-cancellation surcharge, the rolling number of days over which late cancellations are counted toward that threshold, and the additional flat amount charged once the threshold is crossed. Which late cancellations are counted toward the threshold, and when the surcharge is actually added on top of the ordinary late-cancellation fee, is stated in the habitual late-cancellation base policy and in the logging-a-late-cancellation-charge documents, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Cancellations before the surcharge begins | Rolling counting window (days) | Additional surcharge once crossed (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 3 | 90 | 25.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 3 | 90 | 25.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 3 | 90 | 25.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 4 | 90 | 25.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 3 | 60 | 20.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 4 | 90 | 40.00 |

## Points of reference
The two highest tiers, 20-Session Performance Pack and Elite Specialty Coaching, tolerate one more late cancellation (a threshold of 4) than the other tiers (a threshold of 3) before the surcharge begins. Unlimited Monthly Coaching alone uses a shorter 60-day rolling counting window rather than the 90 days used by every other tier of Personal Training Packages, and Elite Specialty Coaching sets the highest surcharge amount of any tier.
